About Me

A student with a scientific mindset and a creative outlook.

I am Md. Rakib Hossain Razu, a Pharmacy student at Manarat International University (MIU), Bangladesh. My academic interests centre on pharmaceutical sciences and understanding how scientific knowledge can contribute to healthcare.

Beyond the classroom, I enjoy photography, video editing, presentation design, teaching and debate. These activities have helped me develop communication, organisation, visual storytelling and collaborative skills.

I value discipline, ethical practice and lifelong learning, and I am interested in opportunities that allow me to grow academically while contributing creatively to a team or community.
